channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Age of Empires II: DE - The Viking Sagas
item.description: Unleash the fury of the North and lead the Danes, Saxons, and Varangians into epic Viking battles.

item.title: Aggelos 2
item.description: With the Gods of light about to lose the great battle against the Army of Darkness, the Aggelos must learn to embrace his darker side. Explore two opposing realms full of secrets, puzzles and intense 2D combat in this challenging action-platformer.

item.title: Bus Bound
item.description: Step into the driver’s seat in Bus Bound, the latest title from the creators of Bus Simulator 21. Explore a vibrant city behind the wheel of officially licensed buses, and help transform it into a pedestrian-friendly paradise—one stop at a time.

item.title: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread
item.description: Embark on a journey to reunite with your bread in this bite-sized 3D action-platformer featuring everyone's favorite shark!

item.title: Mimic Party
item.description: A 1-5 player online voice party game. You hear a sound, the whole table gets one shot to imitate it all at once, no turns. Your take is scored on pitch and rhythm, then the wheel decides who gets a bonus and whose take becomes a fart.

item.title: Mining and Dwarves
item.description: An incremental game where you mine rocks, gather ore, and recruit dwarves. Play actively for maximum gains, or idle and let the dwarves do the work.

item.title: Rewind 99
item.description: You're the last remaining video rental store. From humble VHS clerk to rental racketeer - run your video store and explore Reshoot Springs, building an underground empire. Expand with upgrades, side hustles, store membership, and more. Whatever it takes to survive - solo or in up to 4-player co-op.

item.title: Scott Pilgrim EX
item.description: Join Scott Pilgrim and Ramona Flowers in a brand-new brawling adventure across space, time, and the streets of Toronto!

item.title: SHRIMP GAME: OVERKRILL
item.description: SHRIMP GAME: OVERKRILL is a solo or multiplayer third-person shooter RPG set in an abyssal realm. Pilot your SHRIMP platform to fight giant sea monsters, master elemental classes, and unearth secrets in a 6-person co-op campaign, or just krill your friends in multiplayer PVP!

item.title: Skydance's BEHEMOTH
item.description: Skydance’s BEHEMOTH is an original story set in the Forsaken Lands, a fallen kingdom haunted by tragedy. Play as an outland warrior, Wren the Hunter (the player), and embark on a perilous quest to save yourself and your village. Your only hope is to slay the unslayable, the monstrous Behemoths.

item.title: Space Rock Breaker
item.description: Space Rock Breaker is a short incremental game about mining asteroids in space. Mine asteroids with guns, unlock new materials, process the ore by dropping it into a Plinko machine, and spend your credits on upgrades in a massive skill tree.

item.title: the cabin game
item.description: the cabin game is a 1-4 player, chaotic horror game where you are trapped inside a cabin and the only way out is through a game of cards. Just beware, as the cards you play have a surprising twist on this humble abode...

item.title: The Infected
item.description: The Infected is a sandbox, first-person, open-world survival game. Build bases, craft, farm, hunt, and survive changing seasons. Choose whether to face the hybrid “Vambies” or turn them off for a pure survival experience.

item.title: The Jackbox Party Pack
item.description: The team behind YOU DON’T KNOW JACK presents FIVE guffaw-inducing party games in one pack! You’re gonna need more than one party for this. Your phones or tablets are your controllers! For 1-100 players!

item.title: Twisted Party
item.description: Survive. Sabotage. Style on your friends. Twisted Party is a retro horror party game for 2-8 players with open and private lobbies, stuffed with deadly mini-games and buckets of blood. Betray your way to victory and unlock crazy skins by conquering brutal challenges. Last one standing wins.

item.title: Wargame: Red Dragon
item.description: The new reference in RTS at its best! The Wargame series returns to duty, larger, richer and more spectacular than ever before. In Wargame Red Dragon, you are engaged in a large-scale conflict where Western forces clash against the Communist bloc.

item.title: West of Loathing
item.description: West of Loathing — a slapstick comedy stick-figure wild west adventure role-playing game.

item.title: COCORO
item.description: "Please make me human." A visual novel about a robot longing to become "human" in a world torn apart by rampaging AI. An unforgettable summer unfolds between a boy who has nowhere to call home and a humanoid girl who dreams of marriage...

item.title: DCS: F-16C
item.description: The F-16C is a single seat, single engine multirole fighter that was developed in the 1970s. More than 4,500 units were manufactured and are operated today by 26 countries where the aircraft performs numerous missions that include air superiority, close air support, precision bombing, air defense suppression, reconnaissance and more.

item.title: Docked
item.description: Operate massive cranes, terminal tractors and reach stackers in a realistic dock simulator. Play the story-driven Campaign to rebuild Port Wake or jump into Free Play Mode and take on cargo contracts with no mission constraints.

item.title: DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite
item.description: CAVE's arcade bullet hell shooter returns as DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite. New stages, a new character, new music, and other new elements set the stage for a new challenge.

item.title: Lou's Lagoon
item.description: A cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure: fly your seaplane between tropical islands, collect resources with the Swirler, rebuild storm damaged communities, and unravel the mystery surrounding Uncle Lou’s disappearance.

item.title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Rita's Rewind
item.description: In Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Rita's Rewind, the team faces off against a robotic reincarnation of the Power Rangers' long-time nemesis. Robo Rita has conjured a portal to send herself back in time so she can finally vanquish the Power Rangers by forming an alliance with her younger self.

item.title: PixARK - Terracrypt - Expansion Pack
item.description: Terracrypt is PixARK’s first major underground expansion. Your ship is shot down. A broken distress signal pulls you into strange biomes, ruthless enemies, and a hidden conspiracy beneath the surface—where your choices may decide the fate of an entire world.

item.title: Storage Hunter Simulator
item.description: Play as one of the bidders for abandoned warehouses and uncover hidden treasures! Storage Hunter is a garage auction simulation game. Bid, win, and sell for profit! Become the king of storage auction.

item.title: THE LONGING
item.description: An unusual mix of adventure and idle game. In utter loneliness deep below the surface, it's your task to wait for the awakening of your king... for 400 days.

item.title: The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners
item.description: Saints & Sinners is a game unlike any other in The Walking Dead universe. Every challenge you face and decision you make is driven by YOU. Fight the undead, scavenge through the flooded ruins of New Orleans, and face gut-wrenching choices for you and the other survivors. Live The Walking Dead.

item.title: Train Valley 2
item.description: Build bigger and more complex railway networks than ever before! Building on the success of the original, you’ll get more of what you loved about the original and then some. With increasingly difficult and complex challenges from local industries, the Valley has never felt so vast! ALL ABOARD!

item.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator Suite: Themes Reimagined
item.description: Fully immerse yourself in the world of flight with this digital soundtrack to accompany you on your aviation journey. This suite of 21 unreleased original pieces is inspired by popular trailer scores created by Finishing Move Inc. for Microsoft Flight Simulator.
